description: Resolve one workflow run into a non-committable preview without creating livestock records. Use operation record_birth with template_id and inputs, or operation amend_birth with record_id, expected_revision, reason and changes (amendment_operation amend or entered_in_error) to preview a birth correction or invalidation. Resolves literal and today defaults once and returns structured field/domain issues. Show the producer the complete review before seeking approval for commit_workflow. Never guess a missing required answer.

amendment_operation.description: amend_birth: correct facts (amend) or invalidate the event (entered_in_error).

bundle.description: Untemplated record_birth only: a complete birth bundle (observation-only, existing animal links, or inline new profiles). Mutually exclusive with template_id/inputs.

expected_revision.description: amend_birth: the record revision the producer reviewed.

farm_id.description: Farm UUID; defaults to the active farm.

operation.description: Defaults to record_birth. Use amend_birth to correct or mark entered in error an existing BIRTH record.

record_id.description: amend_birth: the canonical BIRTH record being corrected.

request_id.description: Stable request UUID. Retrying the identical payload returns the same snapshot.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used once to resolve the "today" date default; never guessed.

name: preview_workflow
title: Preview workflow
